claims.explanation: The source directly states that on 8 February 2025, the transmission system operators of the Baltic States started the disconnection and desynchronisation of the Baltic electricity system from the Russian combined electricity system. This is confirmed by the official note from the Council of the European Union dated 4 March 2025, which provides detailed information about the event and the timeline.
